title: Penthouse July 1980 Pet of the Year Play-Off Complete w/ Centerfold Cheryl Rixon
condition_description: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers bright with light handling wear and a little waviness; spine intact. See photos.
description:
Penthouse magazine, July 1980 - Pet of the Year Play-Off issue, original $2.50 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Cover features: Pet of the Year Play-Off; The Scandal of U.S. Military Weakness; American Macho; The Politics of Cancer, Part V; The Olympic Funeral; Would You Buy a "Used Car" from Cheryl Rixon?

Back cover: Tareyton Lights cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
